_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit freely. No code changes needed.
_lead_filter_options: ALL | HOT_ONLY | HOT_WARM — HOT leads are typically the highest-priority prospects (e.g. no website / low online presence) as scored by the actor.
_cost_estimate: keywords x cities x max_results_per_query = total results, billed at roughly $0.01 each. Default config here = 5 x 5 x 2 = 50 leads (~$0.50).
